The '''''Scarlet & Violet'' arc''' (Japanese: '''第十六章　スカーレット・バイオレット編''' ''The Sixteenth Chapter: Scarlet & Violet arc'') is the sixteenth story arc of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}. It began serialization in August 2023.

The arc follows the adventures of two students at [[Uva Academy]]: [[Violet Lang]], a self-proclaimed prince journeying to obtain the [[Herba Mystica]] in order to become the "Prince of Speed" with his {{ga|Miraidon}}, and {{Scarlet|Scarlet Koito}}, a professional treasure hunter searching for the [[treasures of ruin]] by the request of [[Raifort|her client]]. Along the way, Violet gets roped into taking down a group of delinquent students known as [[Team Star]], whom Scarlet also has some history with.

== Terminology ==
{{main|Terminology of Pokémon Adventures}}
This arc gets its name from the [[Core series|core series games]], [[Pokémon Scarlet and Violet]].

==Volumes==
===Mini-volumes===
====Japan====
{{main|List of Pokémon Adventures Scarlet & Violet volumes}}
As with the four arcs before it, the ''Scarlet & Violet'' arc is being collected separately into mini-volumes. The [[Pocket Monsters Special Scarlet Violet volume 1|first volume]] was released on February 28, 2024.

====United States====
{{main|List of Pokémon Scarlet & Violet volumes}}
An English translation of the ''Scarlet & Violet'' arc will be released by [[VIZ Media]] under the title '''Pokémon: Scarlet & Violet''', which will be released in their own mini-volumes as with the four arcs before it. The [[Pokémon Scarlet & Violet volume 1|first volume]] was released on February 11, 2025.<ref>[https://www.amazon.com/dp/1974752844 Pokémon: Scarlet & Violet, Vol. 1 on Amazon]</ref>

==Party changes==
===Additions===
The following Pokémon are added:
* Violet's {{p|Scovillain}} ([[PASV03]])
* Violet's {{p|Cyclizar}} (prior to [[PASV24]])

===Evolutions===
* Violet's {{p|Fuecoco}} to {{p|Crocalor}} ([[PASV10]])
* Violet's {{rf|Paldean}} {{p|Wooper}} to {{p|Clodsire}} (prior to [[PASV11]])
* Scarlet's {{p|Sprigatito}} to {{p|Floragato}} ([[PASV12]])
* Violet's {{p|Nymble}} to {{p|Lokix}} ([[PASV14]])
* Violet's {{p|Smoliv}} to {{p|Dolliv}} ([[PASV20]])

===Trades===
The following Pokémon are traded away:
* Violet's {{p|Scovillain}} is given to Arven for his {{TP|Arven|Mabosstiff}} ([[PASV03]])
* Violet's {{TP|Arven|Mabosstiff}} is given to Arven for his {{p|Smoliv}} ([[PASV03]])

===Terastallizes===
The following Pokémon Terastallize:
* Scarlet's {{p|Pikachu}} ↔ [[Terastal phenomenon|Terastallized Pikachu]] ({{t|Flying}}) ([[PASV01]])
* Violet's {{p|Lokix}} ↔ [[Terastal phenomenon|Terastallized Lokix]] ({{t|Bug}}) ([[PASV05]])
* Violet's {{p|Clodsire}} ↔ [[Terastal phenomenon|Terastallized Clodsire]] ({{t|Rock}}) ([[PASV20]])

* Titan {{p|Bombirdier}} ([[PASV11]]; Violet)
* Titan {{p|Orthworm}} ([[PASV18]]; Scarlet and Violet)
* Titan {{p|Great Tusk}} ([[PASV25]]; Violet)
* Titan {{p|Iron Treads}} ([[PASV25]]; Violet)
* Titan {{p|Tatsugiri}} <!--31-->(Violet)

==Trivia==
* This is the first story arc in which the female protagonist is named after the first game in the pair, as well as the first story arc in which the male protagonist is named after the second game in the pair.
* This is the first media outside of the games in which [[Uva Academy]] is depicted.
* This arc is currently the last to be published in paper format, as the series moved to the online website Weekly CoroCoro Comic starting with [[PASV19]].
